howXpWorks.title: How XP works
howXpWorks.body: Lessons earn 10 XP. Quiz passes 50 XP. Journaled trades 5 XP. Qualified referrals 500 XP. Competition wins 250 XP+. XP unlocks badges, leaderboard position, and prize-wall redemptions. Nothing decays.
